signature.name: Compositor-Clean Loop
signature.description: Whether the animation runs only on transform/opacity and closes its 5s loop with no detectable seam, in lean markup.

bare-wire.signature_why: Only transform/opacity on filled circles, 1s beats divide 5s, scar opacity 0 at wrap and heal is crema-on-crema so the reset is invisible; six shapes, lean.
bare-wire.loved: Six shapes, no strokes animated, and a README that admits no trace was taken.
bare-wire.docked: The scar-and-heal is subtle at 120px and reads as a pulse; markup is pasted twice.

warm-hands.signature_why: Linear 360deg sweep plus zero-slope eased sway and opacity, all on one 5s period so frame 5.0 equals frame 0.0 with matching velocity; one shared symbol.
warm-hands.loved: Genuinely seamless, steady rotation with a single shared symbol, and the velocity claim (~13% variation) checks out against the keyframes.
warm-hands.docked: Animates SVG child groups (repaints, as they admit) and a turning spiral risks reading as a spinner.

the-glitch.signature_why: Transform/opacity only and the wrap is clean, but the drop has hard opacity cuts every second and a deliberate mid-loop slip hitch; ~20 elements duplicated per instance.
the-glitch.loved: Clear drip read at 120px and a pitch that names the glitch risk and the 4px floor.
the-glitch.docked: A purposeful hitch plus hard-cut drops every second makes the loop twitchier than a loader should be.
